carriedPatchCommits.purpose: Test mutually exclusive chrono and time SQLx feature configurations independently.
Record the verified SQLx feature matrix in the changelog.

policy.rebaseRule: rebase only onto a reviewed immutable upstream revision and re-run producer plus Frontier consumer acceptance
policy.retirementTrigger: upstream publishes the SQLx 0.9 adapter and the complete Frontier queue migration/storage/worker acceptance passes
policy.securityResponse: classify exposure immediately; pin away from a compromised revision or publish a reviewed fork repair under the incident SLA
policy.updateCadence: review upstream main and security advisories at least monthly and before every pin change

required: stable, beta, and pinned nightly test suites
default chrono and no-default time feature matrices
Rustfmt, Clippy, documentation, coverage, and unused-dependency checks
cargo deny, cargo audit, and cargo vet security review before a changed runtime pin

rollback.migrationRule: forward repair is required after an incompatible queue-schema or migration-ledger change
